8776907f05d885e069149847589b31708c5fc1f5.summary: Malpedia family page for HelloKitty, a ransomware family that mainly targets Windows and, according to Unit42, first surfaced at the end of 2020. Samples evolve quickly, and newer ones use a Golang packer. The page lists third-party reports from 2020 to 2023, including a 2021 FBI report on Hello Kitty/FiveHands tactics, a 2021 warning that the group added DDoS to its extortion, and a 2021 tweet about the group targeting CD PROJEKT RED.
